tasks.goal: Keep the AKS RP feature/spec/model workspace coherent: tidy feature packets, reorganize specs, remove duplicates, normalize naming, and preserve canonical mappings so humans and agents can review the knowledge base reliably.
acceptance: Feature packets and specs have canonical naming, sourceRefs, featurePathIds, and no duplicate or competing representation for the same product behavior.

forbidden: Do not delete evidence or specs without preserving a canonical replacement or explicit obsolete reason.
Do not mix cosmetic cleanup with semantic model changes without documenting the model impact.
